preconditions.description: The number of blocks in strings t and s must be between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(l_i) <= 1000000 for l_i, c_i in t_blocks) and all(1 <= int(l_i) <= 1000000 for l_i, c_i in s_blocks)
preconditions.description: Each block length in t and s must be between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c_i.islower() and len(c_i) == 1 for l_i, c_i in t_blocks) and all(c_i.islower() and len(c_i) == 1 for l_i, c_i in s_blocks)
preconditions.description: Each character in t and s must be a single lowercase English letter.
The number of blocks in t and s must match the given n and m.

postconditions.description: The output must be a non-negative integer representing the number of occurrences of s in t.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) == sum(1 for p in range(len(t)) if t[p:p+len(s)] == s)
postconditions.description: The output must equal the number of starting positions p in t where the substring of length |s| starting at p matches s exactly.
